decisions.primitiveName: HTMLDialogElement, Popover API and CSS Anchor Positioning

evidence.browserSupport: Per-engine browser lab artifacts are incomplete; native adoption remains blocked.
evidence.performanceImpact: The lab compares CSS anchoring with owned rectangle measurement; no production measurement exists.
evidence.complexityImpact: Separate dialog, non-modal popover and anchor ownership avoids a second modal stack.
evidence.a11yImpact: Keyboard, focus return, Escape, light dismiss, nested overlays and reduced motion remain required.
evidence.securityImpact: No new HTML, URL, property, event, style or import sink is authorized.
evidence.rmtImpact: No RMT syntax or core record change.
evidence.contractParity: Public events and Surface stack records remain unchanged.
evidence.fallbackAndDegradation: Owned x-tooltip, x-popover and x-dialog paths remain default and fallback.
evidence.migrationImpact: Lab-only opt-in; no export, default or SemVer change.

evidence.browserSupport: Chromium and Firefox source evidence exists; Safari and real target-browser artifacts remain insufficient.
evidence.performanceImpact: The model enforces 500 units, 4 ms slices, no slice over 50 ms and at most five percent modeled throughput regression.
evidence.complexityImpact: yieldContinuation is internal and preserves the existing idle/timer fallback.
evidence.a11yImpact: No direct semantic change; input responsiveness remains a measured adoption criterion.
evidence.rmtImpact: Lanes, ordering, cancellation and backpressure remain Source of Truth.
evidence.contractParity: Existing scheduler and hydration budgets remain binding.
evidence.fallbackAndDegradation: requestIdleCallback and timer paths remain available.
evidence.migrationImpact: Lab-only opt-in; no public scheduler contract change.

evidence.browserSupport: Chromium ships, Firefox remains behind a preference and engine-specific WebKit evidence is missing.
evidence.performanceImpact: Upgrade and hydration cost require target-engine measurement.
evidence.complexityImpact: Global self-registration and missing constructor exports currently limit scope readiness.
evidence.a11yImpact: No semantic change is permitted across registry scopes.
evidence.securityImpact: Registry selection remains an injected host capability; no dynamic code or import sink.
evidence.rmtImpact: The component adapter accepts registry capability without importing DOM types into the kernel.
evidence.contractParity: Surface mount, hydration and global fallback remain required.
evidence.fallbackAndDegradation: Global customElements registry remains explicit default and fallback.
evidence.migrationImpact: No component registration rewrite or constructor export is authorized by this ADR.

evidence.browserSupport: Baseline documentation exists; target-engine lifecycle evidence is not complete.
evidence.performanceImpact: No production result for route interaction or hydration.
evidence.complexityImpact: A host adapter must not duplicate x-router ownership.
evidence.a11yImpact: Focus, title and announcements remain x-router responsibilities.
evidence.securityImpact: External URL, target and download filtering remains unchanged.
evidence.rmtImpact: Native events map to existing route lifecycle data only.
evidence.contractParity: before/after navigation, abort, route reuse and SSR adoption remain unchanged.
evidence.migrationImpact: Optional lab adapter only; no router default change.

evidence.browserSupport: WebKit shipping evidence exists; complete per-engine fixture artifacts do not.
evidence.performanceImpact: No Docs performance claim or production measurement.
evidence.complexityImpact: The isolated fixture avoids conflicting with the current SPA-shell router.
evidence.a11yImpact: Reduced-motion behavior and navigation focus require browser evidence.
evidence.securityImpact: Fixture is same-origin and introduces no URL policy change.
evidence.contractParity: Docs SSR adoption and x-router ownership remain unchanged.
evidence.fallbackAndDegradation: Normal cross-document navigation remains the fallback.
evidence.migrationImpact: No Docs pilot until an actual MPA path exists.

evidence.browserSupport: Shipping sources exist for Chromium 134 and Firefox 141; a local Chromium 151 lab executed the isolated syntax, while Firefox has no local artifact and Safari evidence remains Technology Preview 250.
evidence.performanceImpact: The lab adds no productive path; cleanup cost and bundle impact remain unmeasured.
evidence.complexityImpact: Dynamic module isolation avoids parser failure, while productive disposal continues through existing explicit contracts.
evidence.a11yImpact: No DOM semantics, focus, keyboard or assistive-technology behavior changes.
evidence.securityImpact: No new DOM, URL, property, event, style, import-policy or dependency sink is authorized.
evidence.rmtImpact: No RMT syntax or core record changes; resource lifetime stays host-owned.
evidence.contractParity: The lab proves LIFO, exactly-once, Throw, Abort and suppressed-error behavior without modifying product contracts.
evidence.fallbackAndDegradation: Existing idempotent dispose() paths remain default and fallback.
evidence.migrationImpact: Lab-only opt-in; no public Symbol.dispose methods, exports, defaults or SemVer change.
